rootCauses.title: <base href> is ignored when blitz-dom resolves stylesheet/image/preload URLs, so they 404 (dwd.de has 15 stylesheets with 0 rules)
rootCauses.area: vendor/blitz-dom/src/document.rs (resolve_url ~1162, set_base_url ~638), vendor/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs (load_linked_stylesheet ~1108-1150, image src ~1266), image_source.rs:344; crates/script/src/dom.rs:923 (base_url helper, only used by script-side code)
rootCauses.mechanism: blitz-dom resolves every , and srcset URL against doc.url (the document URL) and never sees . set_base_url is called only on same-document navigation (state.rs:397, runtime.rs:1021). The script layer (modules.rs, forms.rs, natives/misc.rs) uses dom::base_url() which does honour , so classic scripts load but CSS and images do not. dwd.de has and the document URL is /DE/Home/home_node.html, so href="SiteGlobals/StyleBundles/CSS/screen/styles.css" becomes /DE/Home/SiteGlobals/... and returns 404. The 404 is turned into an empty stylesheet, so cssRules.length is 0. Same for imagemap_deutschland.png (the broken image).
evidence: RUST_LOG=netstack=debug on dwd.de -> GET https://www.dwd.de/DE/Home/SiteGlobals/StyleBundles/CSS/_libs/_all.css?v=1 -> 404, x15 sheets; diff.json stylesheets sharko rules=0 vs chromium 3134
curl of dwd HTML -> <base href="https://www.dwd.de/"/> and relative link hrefs
sync XHR to link.href from the page -> 200 (base was applied by script-side resolution), yet link.sheet.cssRules.length == 0
Redirect on CSS is NOT the cause: local server repro with 302/301 CSS, jsessionid URL, JS and PNG redirects all applied correctly (rules=3, h1 red)
dwd sharko.png shows unstyled page, page height 7600 vs 2942

repro.path: <scratch>/rc/content-missing-a/repro-base.html (create: <base href="/sub/../"> in a page served from /a/b/page.html with <link href="x.css">; server logs the requested path)

rootCauses.estimatedImpact: medium - any site with <base href> pointing to a different directory than the document (CMS sites, older portals, some SPAs using <base href="/"> on deep routes)
rootCauses.fixSketch: Give blitz-dom a separate document base URL, distinct from the document URL. Recompute it from the first <base href> on parse and on <base> insert/attribute change (call the same logic as crates/script/src/dom.rs base_url), and use it in resolve_url, the image/srcset resolver and pointer.rs link resolution. Keep doc.url for the document URL and location.

rootCauses.title: HTMLTrackElement.track is null and media.textTracks is always empty, so Svelte's <track> action throws and svelte.dev shows its 500 error page
rootCauses.mechanism: svelte.dev's home-page video calls e.track.cues in a use: action (5.*.js x()) and textTracks[0].mode. Sharko returns null for <track>.track and an empty TextTrackList, so 'Cannot read properties of null (reading cues)' is thrown inside Svelte's flush and the app renders its error boundary ('Yikes! Something went wrong', title 500).
evidence: sharko.log svelte.dev: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'cues') at nodes/5.*.js x; chunk source: let t=e.track.cues; ... a.textTracks[0].mode=...
repro-misc.html: Sharko track.trackIsNull=true, textTracks.length=0; Chromium trackIsNull=false, length=1, mode=disabled, cues=null
Sharko DOM has 'Yikes!' text where Chromium has hero content (21 images, height 3012 vs 800)
rootCauses.estimatedImpact: low-medium - any page with <video><track> whose script touches .track/.textTracks (video players, docs sites)
rootCauses.fixSketch: Implement a minimal TextTrack per <track> element (kind,label,language,mode='disabled', cues=null until loaded, activeCues=null, add/removeCue) and keep media.textTracks in sync with child <track> elements; return the same TextTrack from HTMLTrackElement.track. Loading VTT can stay a stub.

rootCauses.title: Module workers whose source uses import.meta (no top-level import/export) are evaluated as classic scripts, and import() of blob: URLs is unsupported
rootCauses.area: crates/script/js/40_webapi.js:2693-2714 (Worker #start), crates/script/src/modules.rs:352-368 (start_fetch sends blob: to netstack -> ERR_UNKNOWN_URL_SCHEME, netstack/src/error.rs:31); JS blobURLs map at 40_webapi.js:1025
rootCauses.mechanism: (a) Worker only treats a module worker as unsupported when the text starts with import/export, otherwise runs it with workerEval as a classic script; bundled workers using import.meta.url throw 'Cannot use import.meta outside a module' (svelte.dev search-worker, reported as an uncaught page error). (b) modules.rs fetches every module through the host net stack; the blobURLs registry in the JS layer is not consulted, so import(blobUrl) rejects (bing.com x2).
evidence: repro-misc.html: Sharko moduleWorker='error: Uncaught SyntaxError: Cannot use import.meta outside a module'; blobWorker same; blobImport rejected 'Failed to fetch module blob:... ERR_UNKNOWN_URL_SCHEME'
Chromium: blobImport ok:42 (module workers loaded over http work)
sharko.log svelte.dev second error; bing.com 'Failed to fetch module blob:https://www.bing.com/...' x2
rootCauses.estimatedImpact: medium - blob module imports and module workers are common in modern bundles, but usually degrade features rather than blank the page
rootCauses.fixSketch: In modules.rs resolve blob: (and data:) URLs from the JS blobURLs registry (expose a native to read blob bytes) instead of net fetch. For module workers, compile the worker source as an ES module (V8 module API already used by modules.rs) rather than the import/export regex heuristic.

rootCauses.title: document.<formName> named property access is missing (window named access exists, document's does not)
rootCauses.mechanism:
Chromium's Document has named getters for
, , ,
evidence: repro-misc.html: Sharko typeof document.loginForm = 'undefined', Chromium 'object' (same as getElementById)
bing.com log: login.live.com DoSubmit: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'submit')
sites: bing.com (login iframe only; not the missing content)
rootCauses.estimatedImpact: low-medium - legacy sites and auth pages
rootCauses.fixSketch: Add a Proxy or named-property interceptor on Document following the WindowProperties pattern: look up form/img/embed/object by name attribute (visible-tree order), skip names shadowing real properties.

rootCauses.title: innerText drops line breaks around block children of inline-block/inline-flex boxes, merging words (probe artifact behind bing/wetter 'extra/missing words')
rootCauses.area: crates/script/js/30_html.js:326-332 (atomic branch: innerTextConcat(inner) trims breaks at start/end, then pushes a plain atomic item)
rootCauses.mechanism:
For inline-block, inline-flex etc. the inner text is concatenated on its own and edge line breaks are removed, so

  • A

  • ...

    B

    • yields 'AB' where Chromium yields 'A\nB'. Words fuse ('shipwreckaew', 'wolkendi', 'anzeigeedelstahlschornstein'), which the probe counts as missing plus extra words. Not missing content.
evidence:
repro-innertext.html: Sharko 'Storm uncovers shipwreckAEW star diesMakes emergency landing' vs Chromium newline-separated; inline-flex

gives 'para onepara two' vs 'para one\n\npara two'
diff.json extraSample bing: shipwreckaew, diesmakes, landingsuspended; wetter: wolkendi, 45das
rootCauses.estimatedImpact: medium for innerText consumers (scrapers, a11y-ish scripts, tests); low for rendering
rootCauses.fixSketch: Chromium keeps the required line breaks of block children at the edges of an inline-block's inner text (the block boundary inside the atomic box still separates lines from neighbours). Emit the inner items' leading/trailing required breaks into the outer item list instead of stripping them.

notes: Known causes, handed over: o2online.de and finn.no = NotFoundError 'reference node is not a child' from ShadowRoot.insertBefore in Lit (310 and 33 errors); vercel.com and zdf.de = document.currentScript null (Next.js turbopack); bsky.app = indexedDB undefined (react-query persister).
